body: Releasing gqlkit or gqlkit-sdl pushes TWO tags on the release commit: the @ tag (gqlkit@vX.Y.Z / gqlkit-sdl@vX.Y.Z) triggers the GoReleaser workflow and creates the GitHub Release; the slash tag (gqlkit/vX.Y.Z / gqlkit-sdl/vX.Y.Z) is the Go module version tag that go get/go install and the module proxy resolve. Never move a slash tag once pushed: the Go proxy caches the first copy forever, so cut a new patch instead. gqlkit-ts: bump package.json, push the parity tag gqlkit-ts@vX.Y.Z, npm publish with OTP (credentials and TOTP are in 1Password item 'npmjs.com'; use a temp --userconfig session and npm logout afterwards, never write ~/.npmrc). Update all three CHANGELOGs before tagging. After a release, re-pin example go.mod files to the new versions.
